CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Work: God Worked? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work: God Worked.
   B. Say Work: God Worked has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Work: God Worked to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Work: God Worked with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Healing the 10 Lepers? (1 mark)
   A. Say Healing the 10 Lepers has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Healing the 10 Lepers to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Healing the 10 Lepers with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing the 10 Lepers.

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

5. Which response best shows understanding of Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ.
   C. Apply the teaching of Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Christian Moral Values: Purity? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Christian Moral Values: Purity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Christian Moral Values: Purity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Christian Moral Values: Purity has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Christian Moral Values: Purity.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Raising the Widow’s Son? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Raising the Widow’s Son with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Raising the Widow’s Son has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Raising the Widow’s Son.
   D. Use Raising the Widow’s Son to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

9. Which response best shows understanding of Judge Deborah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Judge Deborah has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Judge Deborah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Judge Deborah.
   D. Apply the teaching of Judge Deborah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Parable on prayer Midnight? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Parable on prayer Midnight.
   B. Apply the teaching of Parable on prayer Midnight with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Parable on prayer Midnight to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Parable on prayer Midnight has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T? (1 mark)
   A. Use Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Kings David and Solomon? (1 mark)
   A. Use Kings David and Solomon to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Kings David and Solomon with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Kings David and Solomon has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kings David and Solomon.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Healing the 10 Lepers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Parable on prayer Midnight and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
